description: Setlog connects your workout history to ChatGPT through a read-only account connection. Review recent sessions, track progress for specific exercises, compare consistency and training volume, and identify personal records. Setlog never lets ChatGPT create, edit, or delete workouts.

defaultPrompt: Review my training progress over the last four weeks.
How has my bench press progressed over the last six months?
Based on my recent workouts, what should I train next?
